messages:
mira: heads up — PM asked for a 'microbudget snapshot' card in the cost dashboard to show per-route token burn + cache credit in a single line.
alex: +1. need to know the data shape. is this derived from unit_econ or raw tokens?
jamal: raw tokens + cache_savings estimate. prefer rolled-up per-tenant view with a per-route toggle.
ui-tina: can we reuse the mini-sparkline component? UI needs two compact numbers: effective tokens and cached tokens.
mira: quick API sketch: 
```json
GET /api/v1/costs/snapshots?tenant=acme&window=1h&granularity=1m
response: [{"route":"/chat","tokens":1234,"cache_saved":432,"model":"redwood-13b"}]
```
jamal: that shape is fine. open question: how do we attribute shared prefetched cache? today we split by path hit-rate and prefetch origin.
alex: suggestion: allocate prefetch credits by time-window-weighted route hits. simple proof-of-concept: credit_route = total_prefetch_credit * (route_hits_in_window / total_hits).
ui-tina: UX Q: show estimated $ vs tokens? PM insists on dollars. we need a per-model unit price map to show est $.
mira: we have model_sku_map in telemetry. join is doable but makes the query heavier. tooltip should say "estimated".
ops-bot: notice: telemetry index change deploy scheduled at 1769877000 (will affect join performance).
jamal: edge-case: proxy routes that forward to third parties — should be excluded or flagged as external.
alex: also need pagination and sampling for tenants with lots of routes. worst-case query currently 5s for big tenants.
ui-tina: mock idea: [Effective tokens] 1.2k | [Cache saved] 432 | [Est $] $0.016 — click expands to sparkline + 24h waterfall breakdown.
mira: ops question for eng: should we precompute this (materialized view) due to heavy joins? current live query is slow for large accounts.
jamal: yes please. MV with minute-level rollups and 30d retention; recompute every minute. that keeps dashboard snappy.
alex: watch CPU on the query fleet. alternative is an incremental aggregator in the streaming pipeline (kafka -> aggregator -> materialized table).
ui-tina: timeline: PM wants alpha by EOW. realistic?
mira: propose limited alpha: compute only for top 50 tenants and enable UI flag.
jamal: doable. infra work is ~2 engineer-days + a config change for retention and recompute cron.
alex: I'll add quota guardrails so alpha doesn't blow up billing queries — route-level throttle + sampling fallback.
ui-tina: will upload a micro-prototype GIF later today.
sam: FYI ops-bot ran a deploy rollback test in dev cluster earlier today; telemetry indices were fine.
ui-tina: :thumbsup:
mira: follow-up: show "prefetch attribution confidence" as low/med/high based on skew (if one route dominates hits, confidence high).
jamal: noted, will add a confidence column with thresholds.
alex: also add a 'simulate' button: let users flip prefetch split to 100% for a route and see estimated cost impact without changing runtime.
mira: love that — great for troubleshooting chargeback arguments.
jamal: one more infra note: if we materialize, add a checksum column to detect data drift vs live queries.
ui-tina: short checklist: 1) UI prototype, 2) API + MV, 3) quota guardrails, 4) alpha flag, 5) PM demo.
mira: owners: jamal -> MV + API, alex -> quotas + sampling, ui-tina -> UI prototype. sync tomorrow 10:00am.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4321 for MV work.
mira: cool. if anyone sees an obvious blocker ping here. thanks all.
